SELECT primary_key, contract_number, contract_name, contract_type, counterpart, enterprise_code, identity, user_code, user_name, contract_time, contract_amount, products::BIGINT[], money_records ::BIGINT[],invoice_records ::BIGINT[], attachments ::BIGINT[], remark, contract,canceled,cancel_reason,sell_order,deliver_date,son_enterprise_code,money_apply_confirming,invoice_apply_confirming,new_payment_time,payment_time_min,payment_time_max,business_belong FROM ${tableName} WHERE enterprise_code = #{enterpriseCode} AND delete_flag = 'f'
AND counterpart LIKE '%'|| #{counterpart} ||'%'
AND contract_number LIKE '%'|| #{contractNumber} ||'%'
AND user_code IN
#{userCode}
AND contract_time IS NOT NULL AND contract_time >= #{contractTimePre}
AND contract_time IS NOT NULL AND contract_time <= #{contractTimePost}
AND ( (payment_time_min IS NOT NULL AND payment_time_max IS NOT NULL AND payment_time_min <= #{paymentTimePost} AND payment_time_max >= #{paymentTimePre}) OR (new_payment_time IS NOT NULL AND new_payment_time >= #{paymentTimePre} AND new_payment_time <= #{paymentTimePost}) )
AND ( (payment_time_max IS NOT NULL AND payment_time_max >= #{paymentTimePre}) OR (new_payment_time IS NOT NULL AND new_payment_time >= #{paymentTimePre}) )
AND ( (payment_time_min IS NOT NULL AND payment_time_min <= #{paymentTimePost}) OR (new_payment_time IS NOT NULL AND new_payment_time <= #{paymentTimePost}) )
ORDER BY COALESCE(money_apply_confirming, false) DESC, COALESCE(invoice_apply_confirming, false) DESC, create_time DESC

SELECT contract.primary_key, contract.contract_number, contract.contract_name, contract.contract_type, contract.counterpart, contract.enterprise_code, contract.identity, contract.user_code, contract.user_name, contract.contract_time, contract.contract_amount, contract.products::BIGINT[], contract.money_records ::BIGINT[],contract.invoice_records ::BIGINT[], contract.attachments ::BIGINT[], contract.remark, contract.contract,contract.canceled,contract.cancel_reason,contract.sell_order,contract.deliver_date,contract.son_enterprise_code, contract.money_apply_confirming,contract.invoice_apply_confirming, contract.new_payment_time,contract.payment_time_min,contract.payment_time_max,contract.business_belong FROM ${contractTableName} contract WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ${recordTableName} record WHERE contract.primary_key = record.signed_contract AND record.applicant IN
#{applicant}
AND record.approval_status = 'CONFIRMING' ) AND contract.enterprise_code = #{enterpriseCode} AND contract.delete_flag = 'f'
AND contract.counterpart LIKE '%'|| #{counterpart} ||'%'
AND contract.contract_number LIKE '%'|| #{contractNumber} ||'%'
AND ( (contract.payment_time_min IS NOT NULL AND contract.payment_time_max IS NOT NULL AND contract.payment_time_min <= #{paymentTimePost} AND contract.payment_time_max >= #{paymentTimePre}) OR (contract.new_payment_time IS NOT NULL AND contract.new_payment_time >= #{paymentTimePre} AND contract.new_payment_time <= #{paymentTimePost}) )
AND ( (contract.payment_time_max IS NOT NULL AND contract.payment_time_max >= #{paymentTimePre}) OR (contract.new_payment_time IS NOT NULL AND contract.new_payment_time >= #{paymentTimePre}) )
AND ( (contract.payment_time_min IS NOT NULL AND contract.payment_time_min <= #{paymentTimePost}) OR (contract.new_payment_time IS NOT NULL AND contract.new_payment_time <= #{paymentTimePost}) )
ORDER BY COALESCE(contract.money_apply_confirming, false) DESC, COALESCE(contract.invoice_apply_confirming, false) DESC, contract.create_time DESC
